title: The Elite Trial
description: Vorn offers the black seal. Clear the deepest chamber of Willow Dale alone, then face Katrina Steelwind - she has not lost a challenge in three years, and the fighters under her have not forgotten it.

objectives.description: Travel to the Willow Dale depths, alone
Take the trial token from the guardian
Return to the Guild hall in Dalhurst
Take the black seal from Vorn

notes: Major trial quest for guild advancement. Two-part challenge: solo dungeon clear in Willow Dale depths (hard difficulty enemies + boss), then duel with NPC champion back at guild hall. Katrina is non-lethal - she yields at 25% HP and player yields if reduced to 25% (quest fails, can retry). Unlocks elite contract tier and special vendor access. Elite seal grants 10% discount at all Guild-affiliated merchants. Threat/stake: Katrina's three-year undefeated standing among the Guild's fighters, and what a loss does to her authority over them. Giver motive: Vorn only staffs the most dangerous contracts with fighters tested against the best the Guild has. Consequence for Katrina stated in prose; not wired since this is a single duel with no branch.
